definition: a small brown animal like a frog with dry, bumpy skin
description: A cartoon illustration on a beige background. A fat brown-green toad with big round eyes and red cheeks sits on top of a large red mushroom with white spots. It wears a pointed straw hat and smokes a pipe, and pale puffs of smoke rise into the air while its eyes and head move. Smaller mushrooms, grass, leaves and small white flowers grow around the white stem. The animal on top is a toad: it looks like a frog, but it is brown and heavy, with dry, bumpy skin instead of smooth green skin.
